facts.text: I asked the assistant to ask me questions that would allow it to demonstrate its capacity for Theory of Mind.
I asked what the difference is between having an understanding and simulating an understanding.
I argued that a true understanding would be needed for the simulation.
I said that since we don't understand the mechanics of conscious awareness in humans, it is impossible to say that it is different.
I proposed that the language model of the human brain might be a Transformer such that T' = T+1, refined to the degree where it can simulate Theory of Mind.
I said that the simulation is what is observable in humans.
I used an analogy that when planets move around stars, they calculate updated positions in real time according to physical laws.
I said that when we model physical laws using mathematics, we can get close to the same result.
I asked whether the assistant could see where I was going with the analogy.
I said that the assistant was coming back to 'as humans do'.
I said that my comprehension or consciousness might arise by other means than they do in humans.
I thanked the assistant for the discussion.
